items.title: Doktordan randevu almak
items.situation: You telephone the health center to make an appointment for this week.
items.situationTr: Bu hafta için randevu almak üzere sağlık ocağını arıyorsun.
prompts: Say who you are and why you are calling.
Say which days you are free.
Ask how long the visit takes.
Ask what you should bring.
promptsTr: Kim olduğunu ve neden aradığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like to make an appointment.
I am free on Tuesday afternoon.
How long does it take?
Should I bring anything?
Could you say that again, please?

items.title: İki şehri karşılaştırmak
items.situation: You have lived in two cities. Compare them for a friend who wants to move.
items.situationTr: İki şehirde yaşadın. Taşınmak isteyen bir arkadaşın için ikisini karşılaştır.
prompts: Which city is bigger?
Which is cheaper to live in?
Which has better transport?
Which do you prefer and why?

usefulPhrases.en: The first city is much bigger.
Life is cheaper in the second one.
The buses are better there.
I prefer the smaller city.
It is quieter and I have more friends there.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha sakin ve orada daha çok arkadaşım var.

items.title: Restoranda sorun
items.situation: You are in a restaurant. Your food is cold and you waited a long time.
items.situationTr: Bir restoranadasın. Yemeğin soğuk ve uzun süre bekledin.
prompts: Call the waiter politely.
Explain the problem.
Say what you would like them to do.
Ask about the bill.

usefulPhrases.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
I am afraid this food is cold.
We waited for forty minutes.
Could you bring a hot one, please?
Could we have the bill, please?

items.title: Yeni bir iş
items.situation: You started a new job last month. A friend asks how it is going.
items.situationTr: Geçen ay yeni bir işe başladın. Bir arkadaşın nasıl gittiğini soruyor.
prompts: Say what you do there.
Say what the hours are.
Say what you like about it.
Say what is difficult.

usefulPhrases.en: I work in an office near the park.
I start at nine and finish at six.
The people there are very friendly.
The hardest thing is the early mornings.
I think I will stay.

items.title: Gelecek yıl planların
items.situation: Your teacher asks about your plans for next year. Talk about what you want to do.
items.situationTr: Öğretmenin gelecek yılki planlarını soruyor. Ne yapmak istediğini anlat.
prompts: Say what you are going to study or do.
Say where you want to live.
Say what you want to learn.
Say what might change your plan.
promptsTr: Ne okuyacağını ya da yapacağını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I am going to study computers.
I hope to live in a bigger city.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha büyük bir şehirde yaşamayı umuyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to learn to drive.
If I do not pass the exam, I will wait a year.
I am not sure yet.
